stories.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers
stories.synopsis: An MIT-led team is getting up to $53 million from ARPA-H to design safer weed killers with the help of AI. The goal is gentler ways to protect crops, made closer to home.

stories.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins
stories.synopsis: A new system called WorldParticle learns how matter moves, whether it is sand sliding or a protein folding. The researchers say it could help with building soft robots and developing medicines.

stories.title: AI-assisted learning platform helps robots reason beyond literal commands
stories.synopsis: A new approach called FLEX helps robots work out what a person means, beyond the literal words. That could make household and assistive robots much better helpers.
